content.tldr: Clone → configure .env → docker compose up → run migrations → verify ports 3000/5173/3001.

steps.title: Clone the repository
steps.notes: Use SSH clone. HTTPS may fail behind corporate proxy.

steps.title: Configure environment files
steps.command: cp backend/.env.example backend/.env && cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local
steps.notes: Fill in all values marked <vault>. Get values from team lead.

steps.title: Start Docker services
steps.notes: Wait for postgres health check to pass before next step.

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.command: cd backend && npm ci && cd ../frontend && npm ci
steps.notes: Use npm ci (not npm install) to respect lockfile.

steps.title: Start all services
steps.notes: Backend: http://localhost:3000 | Frontend: http://localhost:5173 | Wiki: http://localhost:3001

steps.title: Verify setup
steps.notes: Should return {"status":"ok"}. If not, check docker logs.

common_issues.fix: Stop local PostgreSQL: sudo service postgresql stop

common_issues.issue: Migration fails: relation does not exist
common_issues.fix: Run: docker compose exec postgres psql -U $DATABASE_USER -c 'CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp"'
